pages.title: Dawn
pages.prompt: Children's picture-book illustration, soft watercolour. A small red lighthouse on a rocky island at dawn, gulls over a calm sea.

pages.title: The visitor
pages.prompt: Children's picture-book illustration, soft watercolour. A curious sea otter climbs onto the lighthouse steps, holding a shell.

pages.title: The storm
pages.prompt: Children's picture-book illustration, soft watercolour. Dark clouds and tall waves around the lighthouse, its beam cutting through rain.

pages.title: Home
pages.prompt: Children's picture-book illustration, soft watercolour. A fishing boat follows the lighthouse beam safely into the harbour at night.
